From: Aditi Singh <aditi@langweave.ai>

Subject: Tracing shim acceptance + LangWeave demo plan

Hi Rishi / Marissa / Kim,

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. As discussed, the LangWeave engineering team has a small tracing shim we want Redwood to validate so we can ship the LangWeave runtime/plugin in our marketplace. To keep things tight, we put together an acceptance checklist and a short demo agenda. Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow so we can lock resources?

- Acceptance: Can Redwood run the shim against a small congested workload (20 concurrent infer requests, 1k token avg) and verify KV cache correctness + span propagation for request IDs?
- Security: We'll provide a read-only service token and a sanitized sample dataset; any additional evidence you need for SOC2 scoping?
- Demo: Proposed slots: Tue 7/27 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 7/28 14:00-14:30 PT (we prefer the later if it works).

Attached: lightweight acceptance checklist (CSV) and draft demo agenda.

If useful, Tom (eng) can join the demo to walk the shim internals.

Best,
Aditi

--
Aditi Singh
Head of Integrations | LangWeave
aditi@langweave.ai

Subject: Re: Tracing shim acceptance + LangWeave demo plan

Hi Aditi — thanks for the checklist, looks straightforward. Quick notes from our side:

- Engineering validation: Mateo will run the smoke test (concurrency + KV cache) on a staging pool that mirrors our hosted runtime. Expect a short report with spans and a sample trace dump.
- Security/Compliance: For SOC2 purposes we'll need the sanitized dataset + the list of service accounts/tokens used during the run. We won't persist any LangWeave data beyond the test window.
- Demo slot: Wed 7/28 14:00 PT works for us — please send calendar invite and preferred meeting link.

Action items:
1) LangWeave: share modified checklist + sanitized sample (Aditi)
2) Redwood: Mateo will run validation and share results by 7/28 12:00 PT
3) Commercial: Marissa will prepare marketplace onboarding checklist and any commercial questions for the demo

I'll block time on our calendar; Tom + Aditi please include any runbooks you want us to follow.

Thanks,
Rishi

Subject: Re: Tracing shim acceptance + LangWeave demo plan

Quick update — Mateo completed the smoke validation earlier today. Summary: shim preserved span IDs across forwarding (sample traces attached), KV cache behavior matches expectations for prefix hits, and we recorded one transient latency bump under synthetic load (root cause: a small retry loop in the shim; Mateo captured logs and suggested a 1-line change).

Next steps:
- LangWeave: Tom / Aditi, can you patch the retry loop and share a new shim build by end of day Fri 7/30?
- Redwood: we'll prepare the demo environment and publish the test trace set to the Drive folder by 9:00 PT tomorrow.
- Commercial: Marissa, we'll be ready to accept marketplace assets once MSA is countersigned.

I've attached the demo agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and the raw trace bundle. Please confirm the 7/28 14:00 PT demo link — calendar invite is sent.

Thanks everyone — nice progress.

Rishi
